notes.list_status: Checked against the city's signed 'List of Certified & Acclaimed Candidates' PDF (linked from the same page): the two lists agree candidate for candidate, and the registered list already omits the four the PDF marks WITHDRAWN (Bill Leduc for mayor, Braden Hill in Ward 9, George Lalonde in Ward 11, Deborah Josipovic in Ward 12). notes.source_note: The candidate list on the 'Registered Candidates' page is loaded by script; the names were read instead from the two accordion pages it links, /accordion-2026-registered-candidates/mayoral-candidates/ and /council-candidates/, which publish them as plain text.

notes.position: The accordion pages are headed by ward alone; the city's signed 'List of Certified & Acclaimed Candidates' names the office in its Office column, as 'Councillor - Ward 1'.
